_comment: Field ROIs for layout B, carried over from pipeline_htr.ipynb.
See layoutA.json for the full explanation of the schema.

fields.name: last_name
fields.note: No lexicon: an incomplete name list corrects valid names into other valid names.
fields.label: Name

fields.name: birthday
fields.note: Handles numeric and spelled-out-month forms; validates against a real calendar.
fields.label: Geburtsdatum

fields.name: email
fields.note: Only the domain is corrected; the local part has nothing to cross-check against.
label: E-Mail-Adresse
E-Mail
EMail-Adresse

fields.name: studies
fields.note: Option boxes are fractions of the studies crop, measured with the DRAW_CHECKBOX_OPTIONS step. Argmax over siblings, so exactly one marked option is assumed.
fields.label: Studiengang

fields.name: street
fields.note: Only the trailing street-type word is corrected; the base name is left alone.
fields.label: Straße

fields.name: city
fields.note: External list from Wikipedia (List of cities and towns in Germany), not derived from any data split.
fields.label: Ort

fields.name: comment
fields.note: Multi-line: split into lines before recognition, merged after. The guarded LLM corrector exists as rule 'llm' but is off by default; select it in the field table to enable it.
fields.label: Kommentar

fields.name: signature
fields.note: Cropped for inspection only; never recognized or scored.
fields.label: Unterschrift
